checks.what: Three independent audits read all 819 cards against the Google Cloud documentation they quote, found word for word by the card checker, and the exam and study guides the rest are written from
checks.result: No wrong answers. Four unsupported claims removed, among them a Cloud Run functions card that repeated the study guide's 'one event at a time' where the docs give up to 1,000 concurrent requests; two scenarios that told the same story with different answers separated; 2 ambiguous and 9 unclear cards and 46 minor issues fixed.
